subject.title: [Bug] WebChat: optimistic USER messages are lost (not just hidden) when chat.send returns before the durable transcript lands — full-replace history reconcile drops them

question: Should WebChat require a durable user-turn transcript write immediately after `chat.send` ACK/before agent dispatch, or is the current UI preservation plus fallback persistence sufficient?
rationale: Current main fixes the full-replace UI symptom but still ACKs before the durable recorder boundary, and the open gateway PR changes transcript ownership in a compatibility-sensitive path.

options.title: Review gateway persistence
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/80670 or a narrower replacement as the canonical path and close this issue only after the durable contract lands with live proof.

options.title: Accept current behavior
options.body: Decide that optimistic-tail preservation and existing fallback persistence are enough, then close this issue as implemented with the remaining gateway PR closed or retargeted.

options.title: Defer contract change
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical durable-send design item until a maintainer can prioritize the gateway/agent transcript boundary.

recommendation.title: Review gateway persistence
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/80670 or a narrower replacement as the canonical path and close this issue only after the durable contract lands with live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is in the gateway transcript/session-method boundary, where recent path history points to this owner signal.
